title: Abaddon's Family Business
description: Abaddon's Family Business — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 5A: Love Handles, Backfat, and Hunched Shoulders. Afterward, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Abaddon's Family Business

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 5A: Love Handles, Backfat, and Hunched Shoulders. Afterward, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Do you mind if I ask you which part you enjoy more; taking down Abaddon's family tree or the Abba Labbas? Me personally, I can't stand those little creepy Abba Labbas. Their fingers look like little tiny hot dogs and their skin and hair...why are they those colors? What level of Hell did they come from! Anyway, back to the quest at hand.

Abadunkadunkaddonna was the one member of the Abaddon family that I thought really had a chance to make it. She loved to perform interpretive dance ever since she was a low-level mob. Always spinning and hopping along to the music in her head, only trouncing Dungeon Runners when they would interpret her interpretive dancing as a threat and attack her. Unfortunately, Abadunkadunkaddonna's interpretive dance looks too much like she is about to cast an epic-level nuke, so the crowds always turned on her, forcing her to retreat. At one point, she enlisted the help of some like-minded Abba Labbas, but they only creeped out audiences even more. Now, exiled from the dance floors of Townston, Abadunkadunkaddonna has returned to The Embercore Path and has been put to work by her older brother, Abaddon.

Abadunkadunkaddonna can be found in Storeroom 5A where she has been put in charge of collecting and securing Love Handles, Backfat, and Hunched Shoulders. She has a platoon of Abba Labbas under her command which will no doubt give you trouble on your quest to slay her. When you have braved the trials, return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal for your reward.

Turn-in:

Welcome back, Dungeon Runner! Abadunkadunkaddonna didn't ask you to dance, did she? Good, no one has ever survived a dance with her.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna
  • Kill Abba Labbas

Client level range: 43–100
